+function Get-TaskForgeStatistics {
+    param([AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Tasks)
+
+    $items = @($Tasks)
+    $total = $items.Count
+    $completed = @($items | Where-Object { $_.status -eq 'completed' }).Count
+    $pending = $total - $completed
+
+    $percentage = if ($total -eq 0) {
+        [double]0.0
+    }
+    else {
+        [math]::Round(($completed / $total) * 100, 1, [System.MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero)
+    }
+
+    $counts = [ordered]@{}
+    foreach ($task in $items) {
+        $parsed = [System.DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
+            [string]$task.createdAt,
+            [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture,
+            [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
+        $dateKey = $parsed.UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
+        if ($counts.Contains($dateKey)) {
+            $counts[$dateKey] = [int]$counts[$dateKey] + 1
+        }
+        else {
+            $counts[$dateKey] = 1
+        }
+    }
+
+    $byDate = @(
+        $counts.Keys | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object {
+            [pscustomobject]@{
+                date  = [string]$_
+                count = [int]$counts[$_]
+            }
+        }
+    )
+
+    return [pscustomobject]@{
+        total                = [int]$total
+        pending              = [int]$pending
+        completed            = [int]$completed
+        completionPercentage = [double]$percentage
+        byDate               = $byDate
+    }
+}
+
+function Format-TaskForgeStatistics {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)]$Statistics,
+        [string]$Banner
+    )
+
+    $percentText = ([double]$Statistics.completionPercentage).ToString(
+        'F1', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
+
+    $lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
+    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Banner)) {
+        $lines.Add(($Banner -replace "`r?`n+$", ''))
+    }
+    $lines.Add('TaskForge statistics')
+    $lines.Add(('  Total:      {0}' -f $Statistics.total))
+    $lines.Add(('  Pending:    {0}' -f $Statistics.pending))
+    $lines.Add(('  Completed:  {0}' -f $Statistics.completed))
+    $lines.Add(('  Completion: {0}%' -f $percentText))
+    $lines.Add('  By date:')
+    $dates = @($Statistics.byDate)
+    if ($dates.Count -eq 0) {
+        $lines.Add('    (none)')
+    }
+    else {
+        foreach ($entry in $dates) {
+            $lines.Add(('    {0}  {1}' -f $entry.date, $entry.count))
+        }
+    }
+
+    return ($lines -join "`n")
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- stats command assertions ---
    $emptyStatsFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty-stats.json'
    $emptyStats = (Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $emptyStatsFile, '--json')).Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($emptyStats.total -eq 0 -and $emptyStats.pending -eq 0 -and $emptyStats.completed -eq 0) 'empty stats should report zeros'
    Assert-True ($emptyStats.completionPercentage -eq 0) 'empty stats percentage should be zero'
    Assert-True (@($emptyStats.byDate).Count -eq 0) 'empty stats byDate should be empty'

    $statsFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats.json'
    $seed = @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 1; title = 'a'; description = ''; status = 'completed'; createdAt = '2026-07-27T10:00:00.0000000+00:00' },
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 2; title = 'b'; description = ''; status = 'pending';   createdAt = '2026-07-29T23:00:00.0000000+00:00' },
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 3; title = 'c'; description = ''; status = 'completed'; createdAt = '2026-07-28T02:00:00.0000000+05:00' }
    )
    $seedJson = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($seed) -Depth 8
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($statsFile, "$seedJson`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

    $statsJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile, '--json')
    $stats = $statsJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($stats.total -eq 3) 'stats total should be 3'
    Assert-True ($stats.completed -eq 2) 'stats completed should be 2'
    Assert-True ($stats.pending -eq 1) 'stats pending should be 1'
    Assert-True ($stats.completionPercentage -eq 66.7) 'stats percentage should be 66.7 rounded to one decimal'
    Assert-True (@($stats.byDate).Count -eq 2) 'stats byDate should have two UTC dates'
    Assert-True ($stats.byDate[0].date -eq '2026-07-27' -and $stats.byDate[0].count -eq 2) 'first byDate group is ascending 2026-07-27 with count 2 (UTC conversion)'
    Assert-True ($stats.byDate[1].date -eq '2026-07-29' -and $stats.byDate[1].count -eq 1) 'second byDate group is ascending 2026-07-29 with count 1'
    Assert-True (-not $statsJson.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'JSON stats output should be banner-free'

    $statsText = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile)
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'non-JSON stats should render the STATS banner'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('TaskForge statistics')) 'non-JSON stats should render the dashboard'
    Assert-True ($statsText.Output.Contains('66.7%')) 'non-JSON stats should use invariant percentage formatting'
    $bannerIndex = $statsText.Output.IndexOf('STATS')
    $dashIndex = $statsText.Output.IndexOf('TaskForge statistics')
    Assert-True ($bannerIndex -ge 0 -and $bannerIndex -lt $dashIndex) 'banner should appear before the dashboard'

    $beforeStats = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statsFile -Raw
    Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsFile, '--json') | Out-Null
    $afterStats = Get-Content -LiteralPath $statsFile -Raw
    Assert-True ($beforeStats -eq $afterStats) 'stats must never rewrite storage'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 23 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
